children: Japanese government bond yields are higher, driven by fears of inflation and expectations of rate increases from the Bank of Japan. Concerns about a protracted U.S.-Iran conflict pushed up crude oil prices and U.S. bond yields overnight, helping boost JGB yields. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East ahead of the Fed's rate decision later Wednesday. The 10-year JGB yield is up half a basis point at 3.035%. The 20-year yield is 3.5 bps higher at 3.920%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
